cvEn:
Benayahu Mellet, son of Segula and Boaz, was born on the 16th of Adar 5754 (27 February 1994) and grew up in Adi Ad. He was the brother of Amishav, Yehuda, Shlomo, Yael, Eliyahu, Malchut and Betzalel.

Benayahu married Esther, and the couple had two daughters: Ta'ir Eretz and Adama Ivriya.

On 7 October 2023 he was called up for reserve duty and served in the Border Defense Array Corps.

Second Lieutenant Benayahu Mellet fell in battle on the 10th of Menachem Av 5786 (14 July 2026), at the age of thirty-two. He was laid to rest in the Hut Gilad cemetery. He is survived by his wife, his daughters, his parents and his siblings.

Following his death, he was posthumously promoted to the rank of Captain.
